```{=html}
<!--
Companion to RQ1-spatial.Rmd, split out this session. This file holds
everything from master_thesis_regressions.Rmd and master_thesis_visualizations.qmd
that looks at Flux across Study.Phase, Month, date, or Hydro_Period,
rather than across site/edge-type/distance/elevation.

Moved in from master_thesis_regressions.Rmd:
- "derive Month for reference models" (Month factor derivation)
- "rq1 time" chunk -> rq1_time_trend, rq1_time (Flux by Date.removed.from.field)
- two of the three plots from "transect x site model with replicate and
  phase" -- Study.Phase sina plot and Dist x Study.Phase facet plot.
  (transite1 model itself and its Tran-by-Site plot stayed in
  RQ1-spatial.Rmd, since the model's actual question is Tran x Site.)

Everything else below was already rebuilt in master_thesis_visualizations.qmd
this session (bug fixes noted there carried over unchanged): the
Study.Phase trend-by-site/transect/distance-bin plots and the phenological
period section.

Renamed Hydro_Period -> Phen_Period throughout: that column no longer
exists under the old name, and rather than keep reconstructing it from
Study.Phase (a guess), this now uses the real Phen_Period column already
on master_tier5, with the same Late_Dry/Tran/Wet/Growth levels/order as
the old Hydro_Period (confirmed).
-->
```

```{r, load packages and working directory}

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(lmerTest)
library(lme4)
library(ggeffects)
library(patchwork)
library(rcartocolor)
library(ggh4x)
library(scales)
library(ggforce)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = 'C:/Users/savan/OneDrive - San Francisco State University/ProjectData/GitHub/DepositionSFB/data')

master_tier5 <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(knitr::opts_knit$get("root.dir"), "master_tier5.csv")
)

master_tier5 <- master_tier5 %>%
  mutate(
    Study.Phase = factor(Study.Phase, levels = paste0("M", 1:12)),
    Site = factor(Site, levels = c("GiantMarsh", "SanPablo", "Buck'sLanding", "CorteMadera")),
    Tran = factor(Tran),
    marsh_edge_type = as.factor(marsh_edge_type),
    marsh_orientation = as.factor(marsh_orientation)
  )

# Phen_Period is a real column on master_tier5 (replaced Season this
# session, per Session_Status -- no reconstruction needed here, just
# re-factor after the CSV round-trip like the other factor columns above).
# Confirmed same levels/order as the old Hydro_Period.
master_tier5 <- master_tier5 %>%
  mutate(
    Phen_Period = factor(
      Phen_Period,
      levels = c("Late_Dry\n(Months 1-3)", "Tran\n(Months 4-6)",
                 "Wet\n(Months 7-9)", "Growth\n(Months 10-12)")
    )
  )


```

## Flux over calendar date

```{r, rq1 time}

summary_df <- master_tier5 %>%
  group_by(Site, Tran, Date.removed.from.field) %>%
  summarise(median_flux = median(Flux, na.rm = TRUE),
            q25 = quantile(Flux, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
            q75 = quantile(Flux, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

rq1_time_trend = ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = Date.removed.from.field, y = median_flux, color = Tran, fill = Tran)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  facet_wrap(~Site, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("T1" = "#D85A30", "T2" = "#378ADD")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("T1" = "#D85A30", "T2" = "#378ADD")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  labs(x = "Date Removed from Field", y = expression(Median~Flux~(g/m^2/day)),
       color = "Transect", fill = "Transect") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
rq1_time_trend

ggsave(file.path(knitr::opts_knit$get("root.dir"), "rq1_time_trend.png"),
       plot = rq1_time_trend,
       width = 13.33,
       height = 7.5,
       dpi = 300,
       limitsize = FALSE)

rq1_time = ggplot(master_tier5, aes(x = Date.removed.from.field, y = Flux, color = Tran, fill = Tran)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(group = interaction(Date.removed.from.field, Tran)), 
               alpha = 0.3, outlier.shape = NA, 
               position = position_dodge(width = 6)) +
  geom_jitter(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 1.5, dodge.width = 6),
              size = 0.8, alpha = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~Site, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b %Y") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("T1" = "#D85A30", "T2" = "#378ADD")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("T1" = "#D85A30", "T2" = "#378ADD")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  labs(x = "Date Removed from Field", y = expression(Flux~(g/m^2/day)),
       color = "Transect", fill = "Transect") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
rq1_time

ggsave(file.path(knitr::opts_knit$get("root.dir"), "rq1_time.png"),
       plot = rq1_time,
       width = 13.33,
       height = 7.5,
       dpi = 300,
       limitsize = FALSE)
```

## Flux over Study.Phase

```{r, study phase raw distribution by site}
# Moved from RQ1-spatial.Rmd's transite1 chunk -- shows the raw Flux
# distribution across phase, complementing the summary-line versions below.

ggplot(master_tier5_clean, aes(x = as.factor(Study.Phase), y = log(Flux), color = Site)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_sina(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  labs(x = "Month of Study", y = "Log of Average Flux (g/cm^3/month)",
       colour = "Site") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 18))

ggplot(master_tier5_clean, aes(x = Dist, y = log(Flux), color = Site)) +
  facet_wrap("Study.Phase") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_sina(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  labs(x = "Distance", y = "Log of Average Flux (g/cm^3/month)",
       colour = "Site") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 18))
```

```{r, aggregate per Study.Phase-Site}

total_summary <- master_tier5 %>%
  group_by(Site, Study.Phase) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_flux = mean(Flux, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_flux = sd(Flux, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(total_summary, aes(x = Study.Phase, y = mean_flux, color = Site, group = Site)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_flux - se_flux, ymax = mean_flux + se_flux), width = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ Site, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Study Phase", y = expression(Mean~Flux~(g/m^3)))
```

```{r, Study Phase by marsh group and transect}

phase_compare <- master_tier5 %>%
  mutate(
    Marsh_Group = case_when(
      Site %in% c("SanPablo", "CorteMadera") ~ "San Pablo + Corte Madera",
      Site %in% c("Buck'sLanding", "GiantMarsh") ~ "Buck's Landing + Giant Marsh",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Marsh_Group)) %>%
  group_by(Marsh_Group, Site, Tran, Study.Phase) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_flux = mean(Flux, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_flux = sd(Flux, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

phase_compare_grouped <- phase_compare %>%
  group_by(Marsh_Group, Study.Phase) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_flux = weighted.mean(mean_flux, n, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_flux = sqrt(sum(se_flux^2 * n^2, na.rm = TRUE)) / sum(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(phase_compare_grouped, aes(x = Study.Phase, y = mean_flux, color = Marsh_Group, group = Marsh_Group)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_flux - se_flux, ymax = mean_flux + se_flux), width = 0.2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Study Phase", y = expression(Mean~Flux~(g/m^3)), color = "Marsh Group")

ggplot(phase_compare, aes(x = Study.Phase, y = mean_flux, color = Tran, group = Tran)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_flux - se_flux, ymax = mean_flux + se_flux), width = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ Site, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Study Phase", y = expression(Mean~Flux~(g/m^3)), color = "Transect")
```

```{r, Study Phase by distance}

transect_summary2 <- master_tier5 %>%
  mutate(Flux_zeroed = ifelse(Flux < 0, 0, Flux)) %>%
  filter(Dist %in% c(0.5, 2, 6, 12, 18, 24, 48)) %>%
  mutate(Dist = factor(Dist, levels = c(0.5, 2, 6, 12, 18, 24, 48))) %>%
  group_by(Dist, Site, Study.Phase) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_flux = mean(Flux_zeroed, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_flux = sd(Flux_zeroed, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

dist_plot_log <- ggplot(transect_summary2, aes(x = Study.Phase, y = mean_flux, color = Site, group = Site)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean_flux - se_flux, 0.001), ymax = mean_flux + se_flux),
                width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ Dist, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Sediment Flux Across Study Phase by Distance from Marsh Edge",
    subtitle = "Negative flux values set to zero; y-axis shown on log scale",
    x = "Study Phase", y = expression(Mean~Flux~(g/m^3)), color = "Site"
  )
dist_plot_log

transect_summary_no_giant <- master_tier5 %>%
  mutate(Flux_zeroed = ifelse(Flux < 0, 0, Flux)) %>%
  filter(Site != "GiantMarsh", Dist %in% c(0.5, 2, 6, 12, 18, 24, 48)) %>%
  mutate(Dist = factor(Dist, levels = c(0.5, 2, 6, 12, 18, 24, 48))) %>%
  group_by(Dist, Site, Study.Phase) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_flux = mean(Flux_zeroed, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_flux = sd(Flux_zeroed, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

dist_plot_no_giant <- ggplot(transect_summary_no_giant, aes(x = Study.Phase, y = mean_flux, color = Site, group = Site)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_flux - se_flux, ymax = mean_flux + se_flux), width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ Dist, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Sediment Flux Across Study Phase by Distance from Marsh Edge",
    subtitle = "GiantMarsh removed; negative flux values set to zero",
    x = "Study Phase", y = expression(Mean~Flux~(g/m^3)), color = "Site"
  )
dist_plot_no_giant

ggsave(
  file.path(knitr::opts_knit$get("root.dir"), "distance_flux_log_plot.png"),
  dist_plot_log, width = 12, height = 9, dpi = 300
)
```

## Phenological period

```{r, phen period plots}

phen_summary <- master_tier5 %>%
  mutate(Flux_zeroed = ifelse(Flux < 0, 0.001, Flux)) %>%
  group_by(Phen_Period, Site) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_flux = mean(Flux_zeroed, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_flux = sd(Flux_zeroed, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(phen_summary, aes(x = Phen_Period, y = mean_flux, color = Site, group = Site)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean_flux - se_flux, 0.001), ymax = mean_flux + se_flux), width = 0.2) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = "Mean Flux by Phenological Period", subtitle = "Log-scaled y-axis",
       x = "Phenological Period", y = expression(Mean~Flux~(g/m^3)), color = "Site")

phen_summary_no_giant <- master_tier5 %>%
  filter(Site != "GiantMarsh") %>%
  mutate(Flux_zeroed = ifelse(Flux < 0, 0, Flux)) %>%
  group_by(Phen_Period, Site) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_flux = mean(Flux_zeroed, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_flux = sd(Flux_zeroed, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(phen_summary_no_giant, aes(x = Phen_Period, y = mean_flux, color = Site, group = Site)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_flux - se_flux, ymax = mean_flux + se_flux), width = 0.2) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = "Mean Flux by Phenological Period", subtitle = "GiantMarsh removed",
       x = "Phenological Period", y = expression(Mean~Flux~(g/m^3)), color = "Site")

ggplot(phen_summary, aes(x = Phen_Period, y = mean_flux, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_flux - se_flux, ymax = mean_flux + se_flux), width = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ Site, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = "Mean Flux by Phenological Period", x = "Phenological Period", y = expression(Mean~Flux~(g/m^3)))
```
